description.value: Dinesty Dumpling House on Robson Street is a Vancouver chain restaurant specializing in handcrafted Xiaolongbao (soup dumplings), opened in winter 2013 on one of the city's busiest dining strips. The restaurant is known for its open-kitchen window and a street-facing live dumpling-making display visible from Robson Street. It is part of a multi-location Lower Mainland chain that has won the HSBC Chinese Restaurant Diners' Choice Award for best Xiao Long Bao.
